fileReceipt.reason: User-supplied copyrighted source; repository stores only metadata and distilled notes.

userReview.assessment: The report is useful for human and family relationships, dwelling use and social-space organization, but it is comparatively coarse as architectural research and lacks sufficient construction-detail depth.

supportedUses: mother-line family organization and spatial use
courtyard and compound composition as case evidence
bibliographic leads to stronger architectural sources
prohibitedUses: sole source for joints and component geometry
generalization to all Naxi or all Yunnan dwellings

architecturalContentIndex.content: Settlement layouts, simple plans and sections for Yi dwellings, including log-wall, rammed-earth and column-beam examples.
Measured plans, sections and streetscape drawings for Naxi cases around Lijiang, with courtyard, three-bay and livestock-building relationships.
Plans, sections and interior perspective for Mosuo compounds at Yongning and Luoshui, useful mainly for family-space relations and mixed structural systems.
Bai residential compound plans and sections at Dali and Xizhou, plus brief descriptions of stone walls, plaster and timber framing.
Comparative discussion of masonry load-bearing walls and stacked-log construction; interpretive and hypothesis-heavy, so it remains background only.
